settings.heading: One keeper or the whole academy.
settings.text: Custom padded kit, glove care and tape for clubs, academies and schools. Volume pricing, one point of contact, and lead times we'll actually hit.

settings.title: Tell us what you need
settings.text: Use the form below: club, rough numbers, deadline.

settings.title: Design once
settings.text: We set up your kit in the builder (or you do) and share the design link with your coaches.

settings.title: Approve the proof
settings.text: You get a proof with every name, number and size listed. Nothing is made until you sign it off.

settings.title: We make and ship
settings.text: Production starts on approval. You get the lead time in writing before you pay.

settings.heading: The more keepers, the less each
settings.text: Pricing depends on garment and quantity. Tiers below are confirmed once our manufacturer pricing is final — until then, ask and we'll quote.
settings.footnote: Tiers apply per order, across mixed sizes. Names and numbers can differ per piece.

settings.heading: Tell us about your squad
settings.text: A real person replies with pricing and a lead time.

settings.question: Is there a minimum order?
settings.answer: Team pricing starts at 5 pieces. Smaller orders go through the normal builder.

settings.question: Can every keeper have a different name and number?
settings.answer: Yes. We collect a roster (name, number, size) with the order and list it on the proof.

settings.question: How do we pay?
settings.answer: Through normal Shopify checkout — card, Shop Pay and the usual methods. We'll send a checkout link for the agreed quote.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: Depends on quantity. You get a written lead time with the quote, before you pay.
